blocks.text: Legendary American rock band Toto is set to return to the Philippines in March 2027, with back-to-back performances scheduled in Manila and Cebu. The Grammy-winning band will perform at the SM Mall of Asia Arena on March 29, followed by a concert at the SM Seaside Cebu Arena on March 30. Filipino fans will have the chance to hear some of Toto’s biggest hits again, including “Africa,” “Rosanna,” “Hold the Line” and “I’ll Be over You.” The rock band first performed in Manila in 2008.
